name: Nishiyoshino (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Nishiyoshino village emblem in orange: a stylised letter C-shaped device with horizontal strokes at the fly.
history: Flag of the former village of Nishiyoshino in Nara Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-09-25.

features.role: Nishiyoshino village emblem — a stylised letter C-shaped device with horizontal strokes at the fly
